turns: I'm building a website for my aunt's bakery, Crumb and Copper. Can you help me plan it?
The owner is my aunt, Ines Okafor. I'm just helping her out. What pages do we need?
The main goal is to take online orders for collection on Saturdays. How should the order page work?
Draft a short welcome paragraph for the home page.
I've set up a test server on port 8417. What should I check before we put anything on it?
Our budget is 3,200 euros, all in. What would you spend it on first?
Suggest a simple menu structure for the products.
We want to launch on the 14th of March. Give me a rough week-by-week plan.
The domain is crumbandcopper.nl. What do I need to set up for it?
We decided on dark green as the main colour, hex 2F6B4F. Suggest two accent colours.
Write three short product descriptions: sourdough loaf, cinnamon bun, rye bread.
We'll take payments through Mollie, not PayPal. What does the checkout need?
The photographer is Sem de Wit. Write him a short brief for the product photos.
How should we handle allergens on the product pages?
The ovens limit us to 60 orders per Saturday. How do we stop people ordering more?
Draft the text for the order confirmation email.
We decided not to offer gluten-free bread online for now. How do we say that politely?
What should the About page say?
Give me a checklist for testing the order flow.

Write the FAQ: opening hours, collection, cancellations.
How should the page look on a phone?

What should we track to see if the site works?
Write the alt text for the three product photos.

Draft a cancellation policy in plain language.
Make a short list of what could go wrong on launch day.
